text:
maria: Quick ping — opened a small PR that changes KV TTL logic to reduce churn. Can someone take a quick look? https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/5248

aj: I'll take a look in ~30m, adding to my review queue.

sasha: @aj heads up: I changed part of the batcher key normalization in #5233 yesterday; there might be an edge case where TTL resets on partial-prefetch.

maria: thanks @sasha — I tried to add a unit that covers the partial-prefetch path. snippet:
```
- if (kv_entry.prefetched) kv_entry.ttl = max(ttl, MIN_TTL);
+ if (kv_entry.prefetched && !kv_entry.partial) kv_entry.ttl = max(ttl, MIN_TTL);
```

aj: quick question: where is `partial` set? looks like prefetch sets it only on failure. can you add a comment and maybe a short test demonstrating the reset case?

maria: yep will add. also CI passed locally for me. linking the perf run: https://perf.redwood/experiments/879

ci-bot: CI: build passed — unit tests 142/142. perf-check: median latency 11.9ms (-0.5ms)

leo: LGTM from a semantics perspective. one nit: prefer `is_partial_prefetch` for clarity.

maria: good call @leo, will rename and push. leaving this open for @aj to make sure no regression with batcher.

aj: queued review. if CI stays green i'm ok to merge later today. @sasha if you have a quick look at the batcher interaction that'd be great.

sasha: can do after standup. if no major issues, approve.

maria: thanks all :pray: will update the PR with the rename and add the unit.
